pregunta: cuántos pagos hubo el mes pasado
sql_referencia: SELECT count(*) AS pagos FROM v_payment_intent WHERE eventually_approved AND first_attempt_ts >= date_trunc('month', (SELECT max(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt)) - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AND first_attempt_ts < date_trunc('month', (SELECT max(event_date) FROM fact_payment_attempt))
